Martyred Intellectuals Memorial to be built at RU
2016-08-11T00:00:00+06:00 | A Correspondent, RU
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/martyred-intellectuals-memorial-be-built-ru-1267885

The foundation stone of Martyred Intellectuals Memorial at Rajshahi University (RU) was laid yesterday.

RU Vice-chancellor Prof Muhammad Mizanuddin laid the foundation stone at a ceremony in the afternoon.

The monument is planned to be built on the north-west side of the university's administration building.

Member of the monument construction committee Prof Md Tarikul said the construction work will be completed before the next Martyred Intellectuals Day.
